Zoe C: Quick question  manager wants a promotion effective 2026-07-01 but budget owner is out. What's the process if the budget sign-off is delayed? @Maya (People Ops)
Maya (People Ops): If budget sign-off isn't in by payroll cutoff (2026-06-18 EOD PT) we can still submit packet but comp will be paused in payroll. If approved after cutoff we process as retro to requested effective date.
Zoe C: Any limits on how long retro can go back without exec sign-off?
Maya (People Ops): Retro <=90 days is standard. Retro >90 days requires finance review; >180 days needs exec approval. Include clear justification if you're asking for long retro.
Sam F (Finance): Adding: retro pay >60 days will need additional finance sign-off and may be split across payroll cycles. Make sure payroll code PROMO-RETRO is used. Also attach budget owner email when available.
Zoe C: Manager also asked about partial increases if full bump exceeds band. Options?
Maya (People Ops): Options: 1) phased base increase, 2) one-time market adjustment (taxed as bonus), 3) equity refresh. Each needs budget owner ok; equity needs grants ops sign-off.
Zoe C: Great. Last  if an offer was pre-negotiated above band, do we route differently?
Maya (People Ops): Yes tag packet "pre-negotiated-comp" and include offer thread. Those go to exec comp committee during calibration. Expect extra scrutiny.
comp-bot: Packet created by Zoe C  status: metadata captured. Calibration flag set. Auto-scheduled window: 2026-06-20 to 2026-06-22.
Zoe C: Thanks  I'll chase budget owner and submit today.
